_about: Carlo Collodi's (Carlo Lorenzini, 1826-1890) Pinocchio in two public-domain English translations, each its own work with the translator in its title, as with Andersen: Carol Della Chiesa's (1914, clean Gutenberg text) and M. A. Murray's, the first English Pinocchio (London: T. Fisher Unwin, 1892; raw Internet Archive OCR). Both published before 1930: US public domain.

collodi-pinocchio-della-chiesa: The Adventures of Pinocchio, tr. Carol Della Chiesa (1914)

collodi-pinocchio-murray: The Story of a Puppet; or, The Adventures of Pinocchio, tr. M. A. Murray (London: T. Fisher Unwin, 1892)

_excluded.collodi-duplicates: The Adventures of Pinocchio (PG 19516, Della Chiesa again)
_excluded.collodi-translator-unrecorded: PENDING: Pinocchio: The Tale of a Puppet (PG 16865, Whitman 1916, ill. Alice Carsey) names no translator; it does not enter the shelf until the translator is identified (the 2026-07-26 rights rule)
_excluded.collodi-not-pinocchio: Beppo, tr. W. S. Cramp (PG 78089): not Pinocchio, outside the relay's ask; The Heart of Pinocchio (41446) is by Collodi Nipote, not Collodi
_excluded.collodi-translations: Italian originals (19517, 52484) and the Finnish translation (53077): this shelf is English
